blocks.text: Millions of people now use AI chatbots as a news source to get quick answers about current events. A 2026 survey by the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, which questioned more than 90,000 people worldwide, found that 10% use AI chatbots for news every week, a figure that is significantly higher among younger audiences. Explaining what is happening in the world, why it matters and what it means has traditionally been the work of journalism.
